decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The Council is satisfied that the proposed materials and finishes, submitted in respect of condition No. 2 of planning permission 00106/1/P5, as detailed in the schedule below are satisfactory as they would ensure the new building would enhance the character and appearance of Turnham Green Conservation Area, complying with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Schedule of materials and finishes

Item	Specification	Colour/ref.
Brickwork	'Funton Old Chelsea Yellow' stock by Ibstock (4209)	Yellow - Buff
Mortar	Mortar for the main brickwork should be: Class 3 M4 1:1:5 or 6 Mortar mix for parapets should be Class 1 M12 1:1/4:3 (BS 5628 pt3 2005).  Movement joints should be placed at 6m centres for parapets. On the third floor the brick fluting detail requires bed joint reinforcement to be installed to every 3rd course up to and including parapet level. Pointing:Pointing is to be recessed; Contractor to allow the mortar to stiffen, after a few hours expose aggregate by brushing with a stiff brush giving a softer appearance. 	Traditional lime mortar (natural grey/off white)
Windows & Doors frames	Anodised aluminium (Sapa 'Dualframe')	Light silver (non-reflective)
Refuse Store Doors	Timber (Oak)	Untreated oak
Solar Panels	'Greenskies' by Worcester Bosch Group	N/A
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing building and erection of a 4 storey block comprising 2 x two bed flats and 2 x one bed flats details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (materials) of planning permission 00106/1/P5 dated 31/10/2007.
